verdict.rationale: Polar documents no-code Checkout Links that you configure once in the dashboard and share anywhere (website, social media, email, an in-app button), and Polar handles the rest of the checkout. Because Polar acts as Merchant of Record with a free self-serve Starter plan, a founder can sell without setting up their own payment or tax infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the link-creation flow, and evidence of how long onboarding or account verification takes before a founder can actually sell.
